pages.title: Colossus Heart
pages.text: Tank remnant. Taking hits builds $(thing)Tremor$(), which turns into damage. Dropped by the Wither.

pages.title: Dormant and Latent
pages.text: $(l)Dormant$(): Armor, knockback resistance, and a heavy movement penalty. Ignores minor environmental damage.$(br2)$(l)Latent$(): Ignores more chip damage. Taking physical damage builds $(thing)Tremor$(), which fades out of combat.

pages.title: Awakened, Ascended, Transcendent, Apex
pages.text: $(l)Awakened$(): Heavy hits send out a pulse that staggers nearby enemies. Full knockback immunity.$(br2)$(l)Ascended$(): Tremor adds more damage, part of incoming physical damage becomes Absorption, and the movement penalty shrinks.$(br2)$(l)Transcendent$(): No movement penalty.$(br2)$(l)Apex$(): At max Tremor, your next hit is a huge blow.
